scripts.dev: bun -e 'const c = Bun.JSONC.parse(await Bun.file("wrangler.jsonc").text()); delete c.routes; await Bun.write("wrangler.dev.json", JSON.stringify(c))' && wrangler dev -c wrangler.dev.json
scripts.check: bun run types >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p cli
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && bun build cli/tack.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/cli && cp skill/tack/SKILL.md dist/skill.md && cp cli/install.sh dist/install && cp public/* dist/ && test "$(ls -A dist | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'apple-touch-icon.png cli favicon.ico favicon.svg install skill.md '
